{{Quote|Now, now, my dear. You mustn't believe everything we men say&hellip;a lot of it is just talk and&hellip;protocol.|King Cleroff to Risa|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 101">[[Star Wars (1977) 101|''Star Wars'' (1977) 101]]</ref>}}
'''Risa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] from a [[Technology-deficient planet|technologically primitive planet]]. She was the daughter of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Cleroff]], the niece of the royal [[Vizier/Legends|vizier]] [[Marius]], and the girlfriend of Prince [[Gil (prince)|Gil]]. Upon meeting [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], Risa became deeply enamored of him; Solo intentionally ruined her infatuation, however, when he revealed his naturally unscrupulous personality.
